estimand: First sampled mismatch to own occupied fork symbol (vacancy and either other symbol count); equal-species swaps do not. Retain first mismatch even after return. No mismatch through last observed lag = right-censored. Not a continuous-time survival, tag or cage lifetime; no event-free inference between checkpoints.
cold_population: Native local-all 1B pinned at 1cff504a996508c4b1bc8cdb050abfe560fff911: 128 independent parents per beta (3.2,3.4), paired 300M/500M forks. Verify packed origin against hashed preparation and parent_hash, fixed roster against results/history-overlap-field/split.csv. Entire 6000 initially occupied sites/fork. Verify metadata every checkpoint; 83 lags incl zero shared by every fork.
curves_and_sensitivity: Cumulative observed risk on all 83 fixed times; primary common observed 1M. Secondary decimated grid: zero, every second strictly positive checkpoint by ordinal starting at ordinal 2, plus 1M and terminal. Recompute first mismatch (not subsample full-grid risks). Report counts of sites ever observed returned to origin following mismatch; these retain event label. All arms same schedule.
routing: Only source beta 3.2 original fit ranks 0:48, both ages, may set thresholds, using fork features only. Source dev 48:64 is descriptive/no retuning. Persist threshold file and digest before reading any endpoint field. Score development first, then frozen held-source 64:128 and entire 3.4 (all 128 genuinely unseen), including original-side breakdown for diagnostics. No adaptive update, feature selection or refit.
baseline_key: Within each parent-age, exact tuple (initial species, occupied NN count, sorted multiset of six SIGNED native incident integer swap energy deltas, -128 sentinel for same). This fixes every native incident acceptance and h within beta, preserving much more than binned h. Record maximum numerical h range. 1-sided high opening predicts earlier first-observed mismatch; no sign flip.
high_low: FIT-only pool occupied sites across both ages (same number per fork). For each exact key with >=24 source sites, freeze nearest-rank (inverted empirical CDF) 1/3,2/3 quantiles of s=log(V^2 O)/beta, zero maps to minus infinity. Strictly separated cuts required. Classify <=lower as low, >=upper as high; ignore middle, unseen or tied-cut key. No target ranks or quantiles. For beta=0 only use separate descriptive census, no s or contrasts.
specificity: Compare same frozen high vs low assignments (1) conditional on baseline key, (2) additionally EXACT on number of species-1 NN and category of vacancies in 18 distinct Manhattan-distance-two neighbors (0-3,4-5,>=6). Ordinary packing comparator also ranks a physically simple score (18-site shell vacancy count; increasing looseness hypothesized positive) using identical source-fitted quantile and baseline blocking rules. No packing model fitted to outcomes.
contrasts: Within a parent-age and key/subkey keep strata with >=2 observed low and >=2 high sites; accumulate low/high risk means with common overlap weights min(nlow,nhigh). Divide by total weight per age. Keep only parents with both ages supported; average age differences 1:1, then average independent parents equally. Publish matched risk curves, all-site marginal curve and unblocked frozen high/low curves, arm counts, matched counts and weight, parent contrasts, age effects and coverage (not a population-average causal effect). Empty support = no claim, not zero.
inference: Draw 10000 uniform parent bootstrap resamples per cohort (PCG64 531724), preserving paired ages. Two-sided percentile 95% CI of mean risk difference. Practical margin +0.02 absolute (two percentage points more first-observed changes at 1M). For baseline and packing-adjusted opening in BOTH held cohorts, require >80% of all parents contributing both ages, aggregate matched-site coverage >=5% of all eligible initially occupied sites across roster, lower CI >+0.02, and full CI width <=0.04. No multiple-lag search. Failure of any condition -> no physical-transfer gate for learning; distinguish inadequate support/precision, evidence against meaningful gain, and inconclusive intervals.
warm_secondary: Existing release-linked local physical branches only: l20-b305-production-v1 (beta indices 0-7,9), amended l20-b2711-double-v1 (index 8). Verify local parent_hash/prep state and child/parent IDs before outcomes; map (source seed,parent_id,beta) to static reserve using prior roster. If a physical preparation has independent seed document disjointness; exclude every reserve parent and sibling before selecting outcome rows. No unmatched metadata rows, no static Gate 2 states, no simulation. Within each beta retain common positive powers-of-two grid up to min(1M, minimum terminal observed for included forks), all eligible siblings and paired ages. Reuse frozen cold opening/packing cuts without recalibration (beta=0 descriptive only); apply same within-fork support rule, average siblings then paired available ages then independent parents. State explicitly if no transport support. Warm point summaries at last common sampled power-of-two for that beta are secondary, not evidence for cold gate. Do not combine risks across different horizons, include terminal beyond grid, or treat every release parent as a trajectory.
oracle_gate: No first-observed scoring or outcome access before freeze, qualified native opening oracle and persisted fit-only cuts. Cold fork-zero, pinned snapshot filenames/hashes and schedules are permitted pre-gate. No paid runs.
